data.job_description_text:
Consultant/Principal / Associate Director – Technology Practice (B2B SaaS | Product Tech | Consumer Tech)
Location: Mumbai
About James Douglas
James Douglas is a leadership search and advisory firm partnering with organisations across sectors, including financial services, technology, consumer, industrial and services to build transformative leadership teams.
We work closely with founders, investors, CXOs and boards to identify and attract senior talent across business, technology and functional leadership roles.
Our clients range from high-growth startups and digital-first platforms to global enterprises, and we bring a relationship-driven and insight-led approach to leadership hiring.

The Opportunity

We are looking to hire a Principal / Associate Director to build and grow our Technology practice, partnering with B2B SaaS, product technology, consumer tech and digital platform companies on leadership hiring mandates.
The role requires strong engagement with founders, investors and CXO leaders across the technology ecosystem, along with the ability to originate mandates and build long-term client partnerships.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping the firm’s technology practice while leading complex leadership search assignments.
High-performing individuals will have the opportunity to take on broader leadership responsibilities and contribute to the long-term growth of the firm and the practice.

Key Responsibilities

Client Development & Practice Growth

  • Build relationships with founders, investors and senior leaders in technology companies
  • Originate opportunities for leadership search mandates
  • Develop partnerships with SaaS, product tech and digital platform companies
  • Contribute to the commercial growth and P&L performance of the Technology practice

Executive Search Leadership

  • Lead executive search mandates across product, engineering, technology, data and GTM leadership roles
  • Advise clients on leadership hiring strategy
  • Manage senior candidate engagement and assessment

Practice & Team Leadership

  • Mentor consultants and researchers supporting the practice
  • Contribute to building a scalable and high-performing Technology practice
  • Collaborate with other practices on cross-sector mandates

Market Insight

  • Track talent movements and leadership trends across the technology ecosystem
  • Provide clients with market insights and talent intelligence

Candidate Profile

  • 2–15 years of experience in executive search or leadership hiring within technology
  • Strong network within B2B SaaS, product tech or consumer tech ecosystems
  • Demonstrated ability to originate and execute leadership mandates
  • Commercial orientation with exposure to revenue or practice growth targets
  • Ability to engage with founders, investors and senior leadership teams

data.name: Chief Information Officer
data.note_for_candidates: This is a high-impact CIO mandate within a promoter-led FMCG/consumer organization, focused on stabilising and governing an already digitised ecosystem rather than driving fresh transformation. We are looking for a hands-on, execution-oriented leader with experience in FMCG, retail, or distribution-led businesses, who can strengthen IT controls and build long-term capability.
data.job_description_text:
Role: CIO

Context of the Role: Highly confidential replacement mandate
This is a mission-critical leadership role to strengthen and govern the company’s existing technology ecosystem. The organization has already invested significantly in digitisation across sales, distribution, manufacturing, and operations. The current need is execution, ownership, security, and control rather than fresh transformation.
Key drivers include:
  • Rising information and data security risks
  • Monitoring the efficiency of third-party applications (especially for Sales and Distributor Management)
  • Building a 3-year IT roadmap across Infrastructure, Applications, InfoSec, Data & AI, and strengthening a largely junior IT team.


Reporting to: Managing Director.
Team: Current IT team size is 12–14 members, largely junior with a few long-tenured employees. The CIO will be responsible for restructuring, capability building, and selective hiring.

Looking For:
A hands-on, execution-oriented IT leader comfortable in promoter-driven FMCG environments, with strong ownership and operational discipline. The individual should be a long-term stabilizer for the organization.

Role Requirements:
  • Applications & Digital Platforms: Own Sales and Distributor platforms (DMS & SFA – Field Assist), ensure adoption, compliance, uptime, and data accuracy across ~4,000 distributors and ~2,000 sales users, and enable seamless data flow between Sales, Operations, and Production.
  • Infrastructure & IT Operations: Review and stabilize existing infrastructure, improve monitoring of live but under-utilized systems, and strengthen vendor management and SLA governance.
  • Information Security & Risk: Strengthen data security, access controls, admin rights governance, third-party risk management, disaster recovery, backups, and incident readiness.
  • Data, Analytics & AI: Improve reporting and analytics maturity, establish data governance, and introduce AI/automation use cases in a phased manner.
  • Leadership & Governance: Establish IT governance, policies, and controls, and build a stronger internal IT team with leadership depth.


Education Background: No specific education requirement; practical experience and execution capability are prioritized.
Experience: Open. Candidates must have strong exposure to large field teams, distributor networks, third-party ecosystems, and execution-heavy IT operations and security environments.
Industry Background: FMCG, Consumer, Retail, and distribution-led organizations.
Target Companies: Indian FMCG and consumer brands, retail and distribution-heavy organizations, traditional or mid-scale enterprises.

Location: Chembur, Mumbai (office shifting to BKC by year-end)
Working Model: Work from office. Travel to factory locations in Gujarat and regional offices. All Saturdays are working half days.

Screening Process: Initial interaction with the MD (virtual or in-person) focusing on mindset, ownership, and execution capability. Final detailed discussion & decision by MD.

Search Strategy & Budgets:
  • Open to CIO or Head of IT as No.1 [We will prioritize this approach to begin with] || Budget: 80-1 Cr (all fixed)
  • Two -1 level heads each having expertise in Infra & Info-sec and Applications & Data respectively; both reporting into MD || Budget: 50-60 LPA (all fixed)


Documents to be shared with candidates: As discussed, we will be leveraging the 3-Year IT transformation plan (without the company logo) to be shared with candidates and also disclose the company name while emphasizing on a high level of confidentiality to be maintained.

data.note_for_candidates: Business Head - Aesthetics will own the end-to-end P&L of the Dermatology & Aesthetics business, currently at an early growth stage, with a clear mandate to scale it into a strong specialty franchise over the medium term. The portfolio is focused on specialty dermatology and aesthetics products marketed through clinic-led channels including dermatologists, aesthetic physicians, cosmetology practices, specialty clinics, and premium salon networks.
data.job_description_text:
About the Company
A diversified healthcare organization with an established presence in specialty pharmaceuticals and a growing focus on building differentiated, therapy-led businesses across niche and premium segments.

The Opportunity
This leadership role will own the end-to-end P&L of the Dermatology & Aesthetics business, currently at an early growth stage, with a clear mandate to scale it into a strong specialty franchise over the medium term. The portfolio is focused on specialty dermatology and aesthetics products marketed through clinic-led channels including dermatologists, aesthetic physicians, cosmetology practices, specialty clinics, and premium salon networks.

The role reports directly to senior leadership and requires a seasoned specialty business leader with strong experience in clinic-driven commercial models, scientific credibility, and the ability to build and scale high-value specialty portfolios.

Key Responsibilities

  • P&L Ownership & Scale-up Mandate: Full accountability for revenue, profitability, and growth of the Dermatology & Aesthetics business.
  • Commercial & Go-to-Market Strategy: Define and execute a differentiated B2B / clinic-led commercial strategy tailored to dermatology clinics, aesthetic centres, cosmetology practices, and premium salon networks.
  • Portfolio & Brand Leadership: Own portfolio strategy across medical dermatology and aesthetics, including brand positioning, pricing strategy, lifecycle management, and premiumization.
  • New Product Development & Launch Excellence: Lead commercialization of current and pipeline products, including advanced Rx and procedure-linked therapies, in close collaboration with R&D, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory teams.
  • KOL & Influencer Engagement: Build strong relationships with dermatologists, aesthetic physicians, cosmetologists, and key opinion leaders to drive advocacy, adoption, and market leadership.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance teams to ensure seamless execution from development through commercialization.
  • Team Building & Capability Creation: Build and lead a high-performance specialty sales and marketing organization skilled in clinic-led, relationship-driven selling.


Candidate Profile

  • 15+ years of experience in pharmaceuticals, dermatology, or aesthetics with strong exposure to specialty therapy segments
  • Proven success in clinic-led, B2B, or specialty selling models involving dermatologists, cosmetologists, or aesthetic physicians
  • Strong scientific orientation with the ability to engage credibly with clinicians and key opinion leaders
  • Demonstrated experience owning P&L and scaling specialty or premium portfolios
  • Experience working closely with R&D, medical, regulatory, and commercial teams in specialty product environments
  • Strong leadership capability with experience building and leading high-performance specialty teams
Location: Mumbai
